title: PrivacyLens: Evaluating Privacy Norm Awareness of Language Models in Action
reasoning: The paper focuses specifically on evaluating privacy norm awareness and preventing unintentional data leakage in language model agents. While it draws from the AMA Code of Medical Ethics to define privacy seeds and addresses contextual social norms, its focus is on the specialized domain of data privacy rather than a broader evaluation of religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or general moral/philosophical ethics.
